Explicit structural revision limited to acquisition/data adaptation and removal of unrequested work. Preserve all accepted requirements and public outputs, query as the only public input, actual search/submission, at most the first ten products in their observed order, individual product visits, the real writer at the existing path, and unconditional browser cleanup. Do not add ranking criteria, deduplication, invented values or other business work. This artifact has NOT been approved for execution.
1. Remove inspect_home and accept_cookies_if_present including its consent action: that side effect was not requested. An actually observed obstacle must cause a truthful failure, not an unrelated action or successful empty workbook. Preserve opening, searching, visiting, saving and cleanup; repair their dependencies after removing that unrequested branch.
2. All decision/fact acquisitions must use the discovered observation_complete contract. Capped html/body text does not establish completeness. Require actual success, non-null observationSnapshot, captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false on the affected extraction, with short-circuit null checks first. Read every complete page and preserve original records separately. Never silently narrow, truncate, sample the global decision, or infer completeness from prose.
3. Replace the guessed search selector with an exact observed reference resolved deterministically. Extract one compact array of offered fill-capable controls per complete home page (identity=the observed record.reference plus observed label and only necessary decision facts). each.input must exactly name the bound pages input; assembled result rows is array<array<Candidate>>. Interpret only flatten(rows), selecting one offered ID. Validate IDs against the offered candidates with lookup, then reconnect original records using lookup on reference. A minimal typed foreach projection may collect original page.records before flatten, and selected candidate IDs after the offered-record lookup; field selects an object property, never an array. In a bounded effectful iteration over the selected original control, fill its exact reference with query and submit. Keep local non-null guards and producer action compatibility checks. Do not regenerate selectors/references through interpretation.
4. Apply the same bounded-page candidate-view and explicit flatten composition after search. Pure extraction records observed candidate identity and the minimal facts needed to identify the first products; business selection remains explicit interpret returning at most ten IDs in original order, including repeated selections. Do not manufacture position integers in learned mapping. Preserve every page, validate IDs against offered candidates, then lookup original observations and visit their exact observed href. URLs and action metadata stay outside global interpretation unless that decision actually needs them. Do not use missing or incompatible links, add filters, or deduplicate. Preserve both lookup checks.
5. Each visited product uses complete acquisition and per-page extract.each into compact observed name/description/price facts. Fact fields explicitly allow null when unavailable; every product/fact object remains non-null. Never substitute href or another unrelated observation for a missing fact, and never request invented placeholder strings from extraction. If reconciling multiple page facts needs interpretation, give it only complete compact facts, not HTML or the snapshot. Group related page facts; avoid unnecessary transforms for typed copying. The final product record has nullable nom/description/prix fields and remains a non-null object. Expose observed errors truthfully rather than classifying an empty acquisition as absent business data.
6. Retain one bounded TSV-formatting transform over at most ten compact product records, actual document_write, direct writer filePath/success exports, and the existing always close_browser. Null fields can be formatted explicitly at this final presentation stage without inventing facts. Preserve row order and exact observed values. Do not produce a successful workbook from an acquisition failure.
Use only existing typed output/item/field/object/foreach/flatten/lookup bindings and extract/interpret, with the existing discovered contracts. One result per each source item; nested per-page candidate/fact arrays are flattened exactly one level. Keep this revision limited to the concrete defects above; do not change permissions, budgets, limits, accepted outcomes or unrelated work.
